summary: Embers low flickers of remembrances Radiating Against rock As evening cools. Love lit in the darkness Nestled in those Last flames a torch time can not extinguish #poemsofpresence
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Embers low
flickers of
remembrances
Radiating
Against rock
As evening cools.
Love lit in the
darkness
Nestled in those
Last flames
a torch
time can not
extinguish
#poemsofpresence
